_comment: THE DELIVERY LINES — every branch core's CD (main-cd.yml) delivers, in ONE place (policy
`major-lines-run-separately`; manual Doc/Architecture/MajorLinesRunSeparately).
A LINE is a branch. main-cd.yml derives it ONCE per run (`gate`'s `line` step, through
`.github/scripts/cd-line.py derive`) from the event — push / workflow_dispatch: the ref;
workflow_run: the triggering run's branch; schedule: the default branch — and REFUSES, RED and
by name, a branch that is not declared here. Every place CD means "this line's branch" reads
the derived line, never a `main` literal (`cd-line.py check-workflow` holds it to that).
The SAME file ships on every line's branch, so one commit applies to each: the branch decides
the line, nothing in this file has to differ between them.
FIELDS
defaultBranch — the repository's default branch, DECLARED: workflow_run and schedule run that
branch's copy of main-cd.yml, so it is the line they deliver. `derive` refuses
a run whose payload names another default branch.
branch      — the branch of this repository that IS the line.
pluginsRef   — the MeshWeaver.Plugins branch the line's image sets are built against (the
portal HOST lives there). `vars.MW_PLUGINS_REF` still overrides it per run.
BOOTSTRAP (the first 4.0 set): the main line's pluginsRef names MeshWeaver.Plugins' v4 branch
feat/net11-v4, because Plugins main is still the v3 line (net10) until that
branch merges. Flip it back to main in the change that follows that merge;
main3's entry is untouched throughout. Never vars.MW_PLUGINS_REF for this: it
overrides EVERY line, main3 included.
satelliteRef — the branch of each satellite `satellite-compat` compiles against the line's set.
Every satellite `satellite-compat` lists has cut a protected `main3`, so the v3
line compiles each satellite's `main3` and the default line its `main` (design §4).
label        — the line's FLOATING image label: the newest PROMOTED set of the line. Declared
in .github/release-channels.json with this line; `release-channels.py check`
holds the two files to each other.
movesLatest  — whether this line moves the line-less `latest` labels (the tester's
MW_TEST_IMAGE). EXACTLY ONE line does: two lines interleave run numbers, so a
forward-only check alone would hand `latest` back and forth between majors.
WHO DELIVERS EACH LINE
the default branch — workflow_run after Build-and-Test, the hourly schedule, dispatch.
every other line    — `push` to its branch (that branch's own copy of main-cd.yml), dispatch,
and the default branch's hourly reconcile, which dispatches main-cd.yml
AT that branch (`reconcile-lines` job). workflow_run and schedule always
run the DEFAULT branch's copy of the file, so neither may deliver a
non-default line's commit.
